title: YouTube Integration Tools
summary: This module provides specialized tools for AI agents to perform semantic searches within YouTube content. It includes tools for searching specific YouTube channels and individual YouTube videos.

nodes.label: Agent/LLM
nodes.title: AI Agent or LLM
nodes.description: Represents an AI agent or Large Language Model that initiates search queries and utilizes the YouTube content search tools.

nodes.label: Search YouTube Channel Content
nodes.title: YoutubeChannelSearchTool
nodes.description: A tool designed to perform semantic searches within the aggregated content (e.g., transcripts) of a specified YouTube channel, retrieving relevant information for the agent.

nodes.label: Search YouTube Video Content
nodes.title: YoutubeVideoSearchTool
nodes.description: A tool that enables semantic searching within the content (e.g., transcript) of a specific YouTube video identified by its URL, providing precise information.

nodes.label: Base RAG Tool
nodes.title: RagTool Base Class
nodes.description: The foundational Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) tool providing core capabilities for semantic search, data loading, and retrieval mechanisms that these YouTube tools extend.

nodes.label: YouTube Data API
nodes.title: YouTube External Service
nodes.description: The external service responsible for providing access to YouTube channel information, video metadata, and potentially transcripts or other content for analysis.

groups.label: YouTube Content Search Tools
groups.title: Specific YouTube Search Tools
groups.description: Contains the specialized tools for agents to interact with YouTube content, enabling targeted semantic searches.

groups.label: Core RAG Framework
groups.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation
groups.description: Encapsulates the base RAG capabilities that provide the underlying semantic search and data retrieval mechanisms for the YouTube tools.

groups.label: External Data Sources
groups.title: External APIs and Services
groups.description: Represents external services that provide the raw data for the tools to process and search, specifically the YouTube Data API.

groups.label: Agent Interface
groups.title: Agent/LLM Interaction Point
groups.description: Defines the entry point for AI agents or LLMs to utilize the functionality provided by this module.
